title: asplenium congruum
intro: Asplenium congruum, commonly known as the Eastern Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern belonging to the Aspleniaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of A. congruum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions, but it is traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever and digestive issues.
